body:
🌩️ Sky Breaker Mace

Turn an ordinary weapon into a powerful ability weapon with Sky Breaker. This plugin adds two unique abilities that can only be used when holding a specially named item.

⚡ How It Works

Rename the mace in an anvil to:

Sky Breaker

Once held, you can use special abilities with commands.

🧩 Abilities

/ability 1 — Launch

Launch yourself high into the air
No fall damage after using it
Cool particle effects and sound

/ability 2 — Freeze

Freezes the nearest mob or player
Locks them in place for 3 seconds
Snow particle effects around the target

⏱️ Cooldowns
Each ability has a 30-second cooldown
Cooldowns are tracked separately

🛡️ Restrictions
Abilities only work when holding an item named Sky Breaker
Name is not case sensitive
Color codes are not required

🎮 Recommended Setup

For the best experience, use a keybind mod like
[Bind Commands](https://modrinth.com/mod/bindcommands)

This lets players bind:

/ability 1 → key (like R)
/ability 2 → key (like F)

So abilities feel instant instead of typing commands.

📦 Features
Simple and lightweight
No config needed
Works on players and mobs
Built-in cooldown system
Fall damage protection

🔧 Commands
/ability 1 → Launch
/ability 2 → Freeze
